description: Find recipes on Strega by keywords, ingredients, time or diet. Use when the cook asks "what's for dinner?", "something vegetarian under 30 minutes", "a good banana bread", "something with the spinach I have", or "show me my chili" (mine: true for their own, private ones included). The cook's allergies, diet and avoid list already apply, and their own recipes come first. Returns short summaries with slugs and urls; get_recipe has the full recipe. When the cook names a recipe search excluded, it comes back in hidden with why: don't stop to ask; go on with that slug, tell them why it was hidden before anything else, and never present it as safe. Works signed out (public recipes).

allergens.description: Explicit per-request allergen screening, separate from exclude_ingredients. Use at most nine entries: milk, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree_nuts, peanuts, wheat, soy, sesame. Fixed aliases: dairy → milk, egg → eggs, peanut → peanuts, tree nuts → tree_nuts, soya → soy, sesame seeds → sesame. Nuts and seafood are ambiguous: specify tree_nuts/peanuts or fish/shellfish explicitly. Gluten is not wheat and lactose is not milk; neither is supported here. No spelling guesses are made. Retry with supported categories. Empty adds no restriction and never clears saved rules. Not saved to Strega preferences or plans.

exclude_ingredients.description: Ingredient-name/canonical exclusions only, NOT allergen rules. Use allergens for explicit category screening; saved rules still apply

from_pantry.description: Rank by what the cook has in their saved pantry ("something with pasta from what I have"); each result says what they have and what's missing. For a pure "what can I make?" use suggest_from_pantry

include_ingredients.description: Ingredients the recipe must use, e.g. what is in the fridge

max_calories.description: Calories per serving at most ("under 500 calories"). Defaults to the cook's saved target; recipes whose nutrition can't be fully counted are left out

max_minutes.description: Maximum prep + cook time as the author wrote it (total_minutes). The time range shown (time) is the author's estimate plus a quarter, or the crowd's range once enough cooks finished (time.basis says which), so it can run past the limit

min_protein.description: Grams of protein per serving at least ("high protein": 30). Defaults to the cook's saved target

mine.description: Only the cook's own recipes and versions, including private ones

season.description: Season the cook explicitly chose. A small browsing nudge only without query/tags; unknown recipe labels stay neutral. Never infer from ZIP, date, weather or location; does not save a preference.

tags.description: All must match. In use: vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, dairy-free, quick, dinner, breakfast, dessert, baking, soup, side, snack, make-ahead

unknown_ingredients.description: While allergen screening is active: exclude (default) omits insufficiently classified recipes; flag includes them with uncertainty. Named recipe retrieval always warns and returns the recipe.

name: search_recipes

adjusted.description: Defaults this call took instead of failing (#243): an unknown units word, a number out of range, a diet word read as the closest one Strega knows. Mention it when it changes what the cook gets

asks.description: At most one question for the cook, with a home in preferences

ask_now.description: false when the response also offers a next step: the offer is the turn's one question, so don't ask this now, but save the answer if the cook volunteers it

saves_to.description: Where the answer goes, e.g. update_preferences.servings (after the cook confirms)

say.description: The question, in the cook's terms

exclusion_sources.description: Cause categories present in each full visible candidate pool; categories may overlap and reveal no saved preference values

guide.description: How to answer this turn: rules for you, the assistant, not words for the cook. Follow them before anything else here (#258)

hidden.description: Recipes the cook named that search excluded; they asked for it, so go on with that slug, warning first

items.description: A recipe the query named that search excluded (#99): go on with its slug, warning first

slug.description: The recipe's slug: the id every tool takes

url.description: The recipe page: share it so the cook can follow along (steps check off, timers included)

why.description: Each reason search excluded it (saved preferences, this request's constraints, or insufficient ingredient classification). Tell the cook before anything else

next_steps.description: Suggestions, best first, each with its tool, args and effect. Strega suggests the top one in one sentence; whether any runs is decided by what the cook asks in the conversation and your confirmation rules, never by the wording here

action.description: What the step is, stable across releases: shopping_list, order_groceries, save, fork, draft, share, scale, show_hidden, open_recipe, pantry_update, save_this…

args.description: Arguments to pass as they are; the assistant may add what the cook says

effect.description: What running it does (#308): read changes nothing; write changes the cook's kitchen (a save, a version, a list or pantry edit); order hands a list to a grocer (never a purchase); share is links to pass on. Apply your own confirmation rules by this

priority.description: 1 first; Strega suggests the top one

say.description: One sentence to offer the cook, in their terms. A suggestion: it never states what the cook asked for or agreed to

standing.description: The cook's own saved workflow setting behind this step when it is "always" (e.g. preferences.workflow.offer_shopping_list): a fact about their preferences to weigh with the conversation, not permission

tool.description: The tool that does it, or null when the assistant does it in conversation (e.g. sharing links)

no_match.description: Nothing matched the search: recipes is empty and popular may be empty. No recipe matched the keywords and constraints; alternatives preserve every constraint

notices.description: At most one note about Strega to pass on when there's room (one per cook per week; off with workflow whats_new: off)

say.description: One sentence to mention when the conversation has room; never more than one per turn

popular.description: With no_match: popular recipes satisfying known constraints, with uncertainty warnings when requested; not keyword matches

per_serving.description: Per serving, rounded like a label

search.description: Retrieval evidence: matches require every meaningful query word, allowing at most one bounded spelling correction. Partial is the OR retrieval tier, not a claim that a missing dish matched
